responsibility: Declares the small public interface for GCC’s tree auto-parallelization support. In this module it primarily exposes the query used to test whether a function has already been transformed for parallel execution, allowing other passes or runtimes to recognize parallelized functions.
same_name_distinction: Only exposes the minimal public hook for the parloops module, namely querying whether a function was parallelized. Unlike the .cc file, it does not contain the loop analysis, OpenMP-region construction, or pass implementation.
